					do
					{
						IVsHelpEvents_SinkHelper vsHelpEvents_SinkHelper = (IVsHelpEvents_SinkHelper)m_aEventSinkHelpers[num];
						m_ConnectionPoint.Unadvise(vsHelpEvents_SinkHelper.m_dwCookie);
						num++;
					}
					while (num < count);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
			finally
			{
				Monitor.Exit(this);
			}
		}
	}
}
